etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Americanism from the 1920s, perhaps combining an alteration of fainaigue (“to renege”) with the suffix +‎ -le (“frequentative”), possibly influenced by inveigle; compare haggle.
senses: (transitive) To obtain, arrange, or achieve by indirect, complicated and/or intensive efforts.
(transitive) To obtain, arrange, or achieve by deceitful methods, by trickery.
